items.title: India Inc’s Q2 profit jumps 26%; auto, financials, oil & gas lead growth
items.description: Corporate India experienced significant earnings growth during the September quarter, benefiting from increased revenue and demand. Net profit rose by 26.2%, which is an increase from the previous year's 15.3% growth. Revenue saw a 22.6% increase compared to a low base of 8.2% a year ago. Sectors like automobiles and financial services drove this performance, while others, such as cement, showed weakness.

items.title: Tata Motors PV's domestic business shines, but JLR weakness clouds growth outlook
items.description: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles achieved record volumes and revenue in the September 2026 quarter. Electric vehicle demand surged 90% year-on-year, driving strong sales growth, despite profitability pressures. Analysts have downgraded the stock due to increased commodity costs and margin issues in the UK business. The company's Jaguar Land Rover faces challenges amid weak demand in China, impacting its operating margin guidance.

items.title: IPO-bound Muthoot Fincorp doubles Q2 profit to Rs 779 crore, bucks trend of rising bad loans
items.description: Muthoot Fincorp doubled its second-quarter net profit to Rs 779 crore from Rs 388 crore a year earlier, while its gross bad-loan ratio improved to 1.07% despite rising stress across the sector. The gold loan lender, which filed for a Rs 3,000 crore IPO in August, also raised provisions during the quarter to cover credit risks.
